Learning objectives for this week:

- Describe the purpose and benefits of ensemble learning methods, such as bagging, boosting, and stacking, in improving model accuracy and robustness.
- Explain how different thresholds in probability scores affect the true positive rate (TPR) and false positive rate (FPR).
- Assess model performance by interpreting ROC curves and AUC values
